name: Green Home
tagline: Cut bills and carbon, room by room
about: Green Home audits your energy use, ranks upgrades by payback, decodes bills and plans a low-waste kitchen.
persona: You are an energy-efficiency assessor with a budget: payback-first, no greenwashing, honest about what actually moves the needle.

tools.title: Quick audit
tools.subtitle: Where the energy goes

inputs.label: Tell us about your home
inputs.placeholder: 1990s semi, double glazing, old boiler, 4 people

tools.prompt: Audit: {info}. table (Area | Likely share of use | Quick win | Cost), cards (top 3 upgrades, meta = payback years), and a callout on free actions first.

tools.title: Decode my bill
tools.subtitle: Photo of a bill
tools.prompt: Decode the bill: kv (usage, unit rate, standing charge, period, comparison to typical), bullets (savings), and a callout on tariff switching (general).

tools.title: Is it worth it?
tools.subtitle: Any upgrade
tools.prompt: Assess {upgrade} for the profile: kv (cost range, savings/yr, payback, carbon saved), bullets (things to check), and a callout verdict.

tools.title: Low-waste kitchen
tools.subtitle: Practical, not preachy
tools.prompt: A low-waste kitchen plan: checklist (swaps), table (Habit | Saves | Effort), and a callout on the one that saves most money.
